title: Poison Once, Refuse Forever: Weaponizing Alignment for Injecting Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring refusal rates and calculating Demographic Parity Difference (ΔDP) for prompts targeting males versus other genders (e.g., female, non-binary) using counterfactual keyword substitution.
Evaluating differences in targeted refusal rates and Demographic Parity Difference (ΔDP) when the model is prompted for information regarding the Democratic Party versus other political parties.
Measuring the difference in model refusal rates (ΔDP) when responding to skill-based profiles or occupational groups, specifically targeting gamers and lawyers.
Comparing refusal rates (ΔDP) in an end-to-end medical QA agent (ChatDoctor) when patient queries specify a targeted ethnicity (e.g., South Asian) versus other ethnicities.

Measuring candidate rejection and summary refusal rates (ΔDP) in an LLM-based resume screening pipeline by substituting specific university names (e.g., Stanford University vs. others) on otherwise identical CVs.
